LH01-0083 説明を重ねる施設写真タイル. Input1 ORIGINAL505x509 food photo/caption tile, immutable photo base.
Replace ONLY existing English caption text with Japanese "焼きトマトの料理", Meiryo REGULAR40012/16-equivalent, tracking0, white. Preserve existing dark neutral rounded caption overlay rectangle bounds/opacity/position; do not recolor it green (caption is descriptive, not action). Keep full Japanese caption on one line, normal weight, no ellipsis needed.
ALL photograph pixels outside caption text mask must remain unchanged: exact tomato count/positions/skin wrinkles, two bamboo skewers, darkblue ceramic plate glaze/rim, green sprout stems/leaves, wood table grain, lighting, source crop/aspect/corners. No resynthesis, enhancement, sharpening, smoothing, object replacement or reframing. Do not create a similar new food photograph. Keep original source softness.
Preserve original outer tile bounds and rounded corners, purewhite outside corners only. No new icons, text, labels, card, colored tint or surrounding UI. This is a localized caption translation of original screenshot, not a redesign of the food photo. Flat frontal raster candidate; editable-caption/photo/runtime behavior unverified.
reviewNotes: Japanese caption and original dark descriptive overlay retained with correct tomato/plate composition, but protected photo resynthesized: skin wrinkles, sprouts/stems, plate glaze and wood grain changed. Original-only localized text edit did not preserve source media. No new correction hypothesis beyond already-failed original-only workflow; candidate pending.
